-- intro: :For the magic form, see Barrier Magic.  Barrier Magic is a magic attribute that allows the user to generate and shape barriers.
-- Description:
    This magic attribute allows the user to create and control barriers at will, which usually take the form of honeycomb-like walls made from smaller, tessellated hexagons. In order to use the magic to its full potential, specific spells are required, which are stored within grimoires. While regular magic barriers are typically in the shape of a dome or wall and anchored in place, the barriers deployed through this magic are more in flux and versatile, seeing as the user can freely resize, reshape, and move them around. Though generally serving defensive purposes, the barriers can be transformed into varied constructs, including weapons like swords and arrows, as well as form cannons capable of firing magic beams. This leaves the user with a wide variety of options for attack and defense simultaneously. The user is even capable of covering themselves in the barrier material as a means to bandage injuries or cover exposed areas of their body, or alternatively draw power from previously made barriers back into themselves to power up. Additionally, these barriers can be adjusted to interfere with Spatial Magic, making it difficult for an enemy to teleport in and out.
-- spell pages: Voodoo Regalia; Voodoo Shangrila; Voodoo Kingdom
